role: The abstract base of every entity model: the ModelRenderer box list, the texture offsets map, the texture size, and the render/setRotationAngles lifecycle every mob render calls.
scope_reason: Mob rendering is pixel-gated (out/java/render/mobs_* scenes); the native renderer reimplements this lifecycle per model kind rather than as a class.

members.name: onGround
members.note: swing progress reaches the native models as mob_render_input.swing

members.name: isRiding
members.note: no riding offset in the native mob render input; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: boxList
members.note: replaced by each mob_model's flat mob_part/mob_box arrays; no shared list

members.name: isChild
members.note: mob_render_input.child plus child_head_y/child_head_z offsets and the child scale in the pose

members.name: modelTextureMap
members.note: folded away: each box() call carries its own u,v; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: render
members.note: the empty base: every in-scope model overrides render, and its one super.render caller is ModelWolf (wolves are off in world.conf); each model's own render is draw_model's per-kind entry (lane/covframes)

members.name: setRotationAngles
members.note: the pose pass before the draw

members.name: setLivingAnimations
members.note: the eat/wing inputs (eat_head_y, wing) ride in mob_render_input

members.name: setTextureOffset
members.note: offsets are baked into the box() arguments; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

notes: The mapping is per-model-kind functions (model_pig, model_zombie, ...) in raster_mobs.c rather than a port of this class; see the per-model records. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): data structure or helper replaced by fixed arrays or inlined arithmetic (GPU contract), behavior covered by its callers. Formerly listed as missing: getRandomModelBox, setTextureOffset and getTextureOffset have no native counterpart: the native models are flat box lists with u,v baked in, so the ModelRenderer-tree API does not exist. A vanilla path that picks a random box from a model would have nothing to call.
